title: Universal transcriptomic hallmarks of mammalian ageing and mortality
tissue: multiple tissues (liver, BAT, scWAT, skeletal muscle, vWAT, etc.)
reason: Paper integrates >11,000 transcriptomes across 4 mammals and 25+ tissues, generated new RNA-seq and snRNA-seq data from lifespan interventions, and deposited public data accessions. Provides code for transcriptomic clocks. Suitable for multi-batch cross-species integration benchmarks.
methods_summary: The study generated bulk RNA-seq from mouse livers under 20 interventions and integrated public transcriptome data. Developed transcriptomic clocks of age and mortality using elastic net.
